quarterly_data.quarter: Inspur Electronic Information annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report (product launches): the MetaBrain R1 inference server supports 16 standard PCIe double-width cards in one machine (the company calls it an industry first) and runs the full DeepSeek-671B model on a single machine; the MetaBrain SD200 super-node AI server interconnects 64 domestic AI chips in one machine, carries a single 4-trillion-parameter model and generates DeepSeek R1 tokens in 7.3 milliseconds; the MetaBrain HC1000 hyper-scale AI server aggregates large numbers of domestic AI chips and, per the company, brings inference cost below RMB 1 per million tokens.
quarterly_data.figure: R1: 16 PCIe double-width cards; SD200: 64 domestic AI chips, 4-trillion-parameter model, 7.3 milliseconds per token; HC1000: below RMB 1 per million tokens

quarterly_data.quarter: Inspur Electronic Information annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: the company says it has ranked first in China's liquid-cooled server market for 4 consecutive years. Its MetaBrain compute factory, put into operation in early 2025, built a 10MW intelligent computing center in only 120 days using prefabricated, modular construction; its high-density compute pods raised the load limit of air-cooled racks to 50kW and of liquid-cooled racks to 130kW, and PUE fell below 1.1.
quarterly_data.figure: 10MW center built in 120 days; air-cooled racks 50kW; liquid-cooled racks 130kW; PUE below 1.1

quarterly_data.quarter: Inspur Electronic Information annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (2025 annual report): the company expects 2026 to be the year of large-scale commercial AI application and says that, with the arrival of the agent era, inference compute demand will far exceed training compute; it will keep pursuing AI systems with faster token generation and lower token cost.
